caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, rounded pottery vessel set against a plain, light beige background. The vessel is primarily brown in color with a reddish tint and features various decorative patterns in lighter shades, possibly cream or light tan. Around the neck of the vessel, there are wavy and zigzag lines encircling its circumference. The body of the vessel displays two prominent vertical design elements: on the left, a diamond grid pattern with small dots at the intersections, and on the right, a stylized leafy or fern-like motif extending upward. The vessel has a wide mouth with a slightly flared rim, and shadows suggest a three-dimensional form. The artist’s signature appears in the lower left corner of the drawing.
title: Pa. German Jar
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
